home.content:
We are a queer-feminist self-led group, taking care of a house and a piece of land in the Mazovian countryside. Our main goal is to make space available for workshops, camps, rest, relaxation, etc. for people and groups facing discrimination, as well as those who work against exclusion and discrimination, advocating for social and environmental justice.
In particular, we are committed to making our space welcoming and safer for transgender people, sex workers, activists experiencing political repressions and all those who are tired and burned out by activism for freedom and justice.
home.aboutSpace:
There is plenty of space here. We are surrounded by forests, medows and fields, with a little pond just behind our house. the farm itself consist of couple of buildings - an old barn which is going to become our main workshop space in the future, three workshop spaces and house with an attic.
At the moment we have the capacity to host groups of 6-8 people and bigger groups in summer (camping and working outside in provided outdoor facilities).

supportUs.title: Support us
supportUs.content:
We appreciate any kind of physical help, if you want to come and help by doing something, drop us a line, we'll tell you, what is currently going on and what kind of help would be useful.
If you have any knowledge or skills in the areas of construction, electrics, renovation, roofing, windowing, etc you would like to share, we would be very happy to learn!
